newsitem.title: USA: CME May lumber up over $11 in expanded limits.
newsitem.headline: CME May lumber up over $11 in expanded limits.

text.p: May CME lumber futures ran up as much as $11.80 per thousand board feet in an expanded daily limit of $15.00 while limitless March shot up $23.20 on continued short covering and technical buying, traders said.
March was up $23.20 at $384.80 per tbf and May up $11.50 at $368.20 per tbf. Other months were up $6.40 to $1.50.

A technical rebound on an oversold condition turned futures up from the start despite two days of limit losses. Locals were forced to cover shorts which reinforced the advance. Buyers were trying to fill gaps in the chart which recorded three gaps in the last three-week $60 setback, they said.
